measurement: Domain capability score (Cortex scoring.md SC-02, SC-03): how far Sector can trust the Generation Brain's published dam release picture (status, measured release, the operator's schedule). Not operational health, not production readiness, not comparable with any other Brain's score.
question: Per dam lake, does the Generation Brain publish the operator's measured release and posted schedule, current, from sources Sector is allowed to read, with parsers proven on real responses, and has the published picture matched the operators' own schedules over the pre-registered week (GENERATION_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5)?
scope: Coverage over DAM lakes (/brains/generation.fleet.damLakeCount, 401 in catalog generation-dams-2026-11-22.1), not the 621-lake directory: the 220 lakes without a dam have no release by definition. Quality shares over supported lakes (/brains/generation.supportedLakeCount: state kind OBSERVED or SCHEDULE_ONLY). Validation fleet-wide.
dimensionClasses: Cortex scoring.md SC-09: CAP, COV, PRED, VAL, ENG, VOL. This draft has no ENG or VOL dimension.
unscoredWhen: The registry /brains/generation is absent or has never carried lastSuccessfulRun. The scorer then writes NO score block: UNSCORED, never 0. Today this holds (PARKED, no executor, run.py --write refuses: BLOCKED_AWAITING_APPROVED_RELEASE).

dimensions.label: Release measured by the operator (not schedule-only, not downstream-only)
dimensions.note: SCHEDULE_ONLY states (the operator's plan without a measured release) and DOWNSTREAM_ONLY (a USGS gauge below the dam, labelled as such) are published honestly but earn nothing here.

dimensions.label: Operator schedule published where operators post one
dimensions.fact: count of /lakes/{k}/states/generation with a non-empty schedule.windows / (fleet.byGroup.TVA + fleet.byGroup.TVA_CUMBERLAND + fleet.byGroup.SWPA_USACE)
dimensions.note: Schedules (start / stop times) exist only for TVA, the TVA-published Cumberland projects and SWPA (plan section 3, about 39 lakes). The denominator is those groups, so binding more measured-only CWMS or RISE lakes never lowers this share (the scoring.md CG-2.8-4 concern).

dimensions.label: Supported lakes current (not stale)
dimensions.note: A release picture past freshUntil is worse than none for the tile; the Brain marks it stale rather than serving it.

validationStatusMeaning.source: docs/brains/GENERATION_BRAIN_PLAN.md section 5, registered before any run. Thresholds are the plan's (not restated or moved here); a FAIL is reported as a FAIL.
validationStatusMeaning.VALIDATED: All five pre-registered metrics PASS (hour agreement, transition latency, schedule fidelity, no invented values, freshness) over the 7-day window (>= 2 weekdays, >= 1 weekend day) on every lake with a schedule bound and readable, at least the 17 bound today.
validationStatusMeaning.PARTIAL: Metrics 3 (schedule fidelity), 4 (no invented values) and 5 (freshness) PASS; metric 1 or 2 FAILED or not yet scored.
validationStatusMeaning.NOT_VALIDATED: Anything else. Metric 4 failing (an invented unit count, a sourceless discharge, a status other than UNKNOWN with no source) is always NOT_VALIDATED.
validationStatusMeaning.whoSetsIt: The validation record under docs/cortex/ (plan section 5) and the reviewed change that writes /validation/generation, never the scorer.

liftPath.arithmetic: damCoverage ladder(17/401 = 4.2 %) = 1 x 25 = 25; measuredRelease 10 x 20 = 200; scheduleCoverage 17/39 = 0.436 -> 4.4 x 15 = 65; currency 10 x 10 = 100; validation 0 x 30 = 0; uncapped (25 + 200 + 65 + 100 + 0) / 100 = 3.9; caps: release 2.0 (if unapproved), sourceAccess 3.0, realResponseFixtures 3.0, coverage 3.0, validation 5.0
liftPath.effect: 2.0 / 10 while the release is unapproved, 3.0 once it is approved; uncapped 3.9 shown beside it.
